name: Elevation
definition: Median ground elevation in the analysis window.
why_it_matters: University Valley's no-thaw regime is a high-elevation setting. Victoria Valley's snow-recharge site is near 450 m. Elevation alone does not identify either regime.
proxy_limitations: A DEM is a surface, not a climate record. Do not threshold elevation as a Mars-analog score.

name: Median slope
definition: Median slope computed from the best available open DEM inside the analysis window.
why_it_matters: Separates flat sand-sheet and crater-fill surfaces from caldera walls, lava channels, and crater rims.
proxy_limitations: Slope does not distinguish pahoehoe from aa, or melt breccia from lake sediment.

name: 95th percentile slope
definition: 95th percentile of pixel slopes inside the analysis window.
why_it_matters: Captures rough lava and crater-rim terrain that a median slope can hide.
proxy_limitations: Depends on DEM resolution. A 30 m DEM understates aa roughness.

name: One-kilometer relief
definition: Difference between the 98th and 2nd percentile elevations inside a 1 km window.
why_it_matters: Sand-sheet and valley-floor analogs are low-relief. Caldera rims and impact terraces are not.
proxy_limitations: Percentile relief reduces the effect of one bad DEM pixel and still mixes geologic units.

name: Terrain ruggedness
definition: Mean terrain ruggedness index at a 100 m window, from the DEM.
why_it_matters: A roughness screen for lava and crater breccia. It is not a map of lava tubes or hydrothermal pipes.
proxy_limitations: Radar backscatter is only an alternate and mixes moisture, ice, and slope. Neither product sees a tube interior.

name: Summer NDVI
definition: Median NDVI from snow-free summer observations.
why_it_matters: The studied lava and sand-sheet surfaces are sparsely vegetated. Low NDVI is a screen, not evidence of a Mars process.
proxy_limitations: Bare soil, rock, and dark lava can share a low NDVI. Polar summer imagery is seasonal.

name: Bare-ground fraction
definition: Fraction of valid summer pixels below a declared NDVI bare threshold.
why_it_matters: Supports the sparse-vegetation screen used at Mauna Loa and Dyngjusandur.
proxy_limitations: The threshold is a convention. Dark basalt and shadow can be counted as bare. The threshold must be fixed before search and not tuned to recover the reference sites.

name: Snow persistence
definition: Fraction of valid observations classified as snow.
why_it_matters: Thin or persistent snow changes ice-table stability at University Valley and Victoria Valley.
proxy_limitations: MODIS snow is about 500 m. It does not measure the thin deposits used in the University Valley model.

name: Summer maximum land-surface temperature
definition: Maximum clear-sky land-surface temperature during local summer.
why_it_matters: Helps separate surfaces that warm above freezing from the cold upper Dry Valleys. Surface temperature can exceed air temperature in University Valley.
proxy_limitations: One-kilometer LST mixes valley floors and walls. Clouds remove the warmest days.

name: Winter minimum land-surface temperature
definition: Minimum clear-sky land-surface temperature during local winter.
why_it_matters: Records the cold extreme relevant to dry permafrost and polar-desert polygons.
proxy_limitations: Polar night and clouds leave gaps. LST is not air temperature and not ground temperature at the ice table.

name: Days with air temperature above freezing
definition: Count of days per year with daily mean air temperature above 0 C.
why_it_matters: Marinova et al. treat zero degree-days above freezing as a defining condition for University Valley's dry active layer. Haughton's 50-70 cm active layer requires seasonal thaw. Lower Taylor Valley also thaws.
proxy_limitations: NASA POWER is a model grid, not a Dry Valley station. It does not measure ice-table depth. The 50 km window matches the coarse climate grid rather than the valley floor.

name: Annual precipitation
definition: Mean annual precipitation.
why_it_matters: Hyperarid climate is part of the Dry Valley and Askja sand-sheet setting. Askja's rain shadow is described as about 450 mm/yr on the Wikipedia page, which is not hyperarid in the Antarctic sense.
proxy_limitations: Reanalysis precipitation is poor in polar deserts and in the Icelandic rain shadow. Do not treat one aridity threshold as shared by all four analogs.

name: Mean relative humidity
definition: Annual mean relative humidity.
why_it_matters: University Valley is described at about 50% relative humidity, and humidity controls vapor diffusion to ground ice.
proxy_limitations: A grid humidity is not the vapor gradient between the ice table and the soil. Schorghofer's survival argument depends on that local gradient.

name: GLiM lithology class
definition: Dominant first-level lithology class from GLiM.
why_it_matters: Keeps carbonate Haughton from being scored as a basalt match to Mauna Loa or Askja.
proxy_limitations: The class is a coarse map unit. It does not resolve pahoehoe, aa, sand-sheet facies, or hydrothermal pipes.

name: EMIT clay fraction
definition: Fraction of valid EMIT pixels identified as clay minerals.
why_it_matters: A surface check on the smectite reported in Mauna Loa pahoehoe rinds.
proxy_limitations: EMIT observes about 52 N to 52 S and misses the other three analogs. It does not see the top 2-3 cm profile or a lava-tube interior. Missing stays missing.

name: EMIT sulfate fraction
definition: Fraction of valid EMIT pixels identified as sulfates.
why_it_matters: Surface sulfate is relevant to the Mauna Loa secondary-salt claim only where EMIT has coverage.
proxy_limitations: Tube salts were sampled underground. EMIT does not cover University Valley, where the salt claim is about an ice table.

name: EMIT iron-oxide or hydroxide fraction
definition: Fraction of valid EMIT pixels identified as iron oxides or hydroxides.
why_it_matters: Ferric rinds are part of the field description of Mauna Loa hydrous alteration.
proxy_limitations: Same latitude mask and depth limit as the other EMIT features.

name: Distance to a mapped impact structure
definition: Distance to the nearest confirmed structure in the Earth Impact Database.
why_it_matters: Used only for the Haughton impact-process family. It locates candidate craters. It does not show hydrothermal minerals.
proxy_limitations: Most Earth craters are not polar-desert carbonate targets. Distance is not an alteration index. The Haughton database page did not load in this pass.

name: Ice-table depth
definition: Measured depth from the ground surface to ice-cemented ground or massive ice.
why_it_matters: This is the observation that makes University Valley, Beacon Valley, and Victoria Valley ground-ice analogs.
proxy_limitations: Not recoverable from the global layers in this catalog. Do not substitute snow persistence or a temperature grid.

name: Ground-ice type
definition: Field class: dry permafrost, ice-cemented pore ice, or massive ice.
why_it_matters: University Valley and Beacon Valley are different ice types. Polygons occur over both.
proxy_limitations: Requires a pit, core, or geophysics. Patterned ground is not a substitute.

name: Soluble-salt gradient
definition: Direction and magnitude of soluble salts from the surface toward the ice table or brine source.
why_it_matters: Near-surface salts at University Valley indicate little downward water movement. Lower Taylor Valley and Don Juan Pond record different water paths.
proxy_limitations: Laboratory chemistry. EMIT does not cover the Dry Valleys and would not recover a depth gradient anyway.

name: Microbial biomass or community detection
definition: Measured biomass, activity, or sequenced community from a soil, brine, or rock sample.
why_it_matters: Habitability claims at University Valley, Blood Falls, lava tubes, and Haughton are sample results.
proxy_limitations: No public global layer in this catalog measures biomass.

name: Lava morphology class
definition: Field or geologic-map class such as pahoehoe or aa, plus the mapped flow age where the map states it.
why_it_matters: The Mauna Loa alteration samples are horizontal pahoehoe, and the age split is about 200 years versus older than about 400 years.
proxy_limitations: The Hawaii geologic map can label units locally. Roughness and NDVI cannot assign the class or the age globally.

name: Lava-tube interior
definition: Presence of a tube, its surveyed interior, and minerals or communities sampled inside it.
why_it_matters: The Mars-relevant salts and biology at the Mauna Loa tubes were measured underground.
proxy_limitations: Surface geophysics in the study did not recover tube dimensions. Orbital imagery does not sample the interior.

name: Hydrothermal mineral setting
definition: One of the four Haughton settings and its reported mineral assemblage and temperature stage.
why_it_matters: This is the impact-hydrothermal analog. It is a mapped mineral setting, not a round crater shape.
proxy_limitations: The Osinski map is a paper figure. Impact distance does not identify which setting is present.
